notes.title: LSF 1 Liberation Special Forces version 0.996 Weapons and tactics in store!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047760/65658c36eb4d2500fa4d28484d7a7300c6f29c3a.png[/img]
It is been a long time with no updates but this one is pretty good, solid and full of stuff, remember those typical 5 or 10 weapons now there are a lot more with special characteistics and the way to lead your team is better. 

- You now have the SFPAD that aka tablet of combat or combat tablet, you can easilt lead your team through that. 
- You have an infinite amount of groups to lead them and fight hard with the brain. 
- You have drones and turrets as robots to elimanate locate the enemy easily.
